newsitem.title: USA: FPC Crystal River 3 seen up Thursday - NRC.
newsitem.headline: FPC Crystal River 3 seen up Thursday - NRC.

text.p: Florida Power Corp's (FPC) 825 megawatt (MW) Crystal River 3 nuclear unit was expected to resume operation Thursday Sept 19, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
FPC spokeswoman Melodye Hendrix could not immediately confirm the restart date.
The unit in Red Level, Fla., was shut Sept 2 to replace a leaky section of a line that feeds lubrication oil to its turbine shaft.
Crystal River 3 produces 15 percent of the electricity FPC delivers in its Florida service territory.
The facility also has four fossil-fueled units, with a combined generating capacity of 2,276 MW.
Florida Power, a subsidiary of Florida Progress Corp, is the operator and majority owner of Crystal River 3. Ten Florida municipal utilities own the remaining interests in the unit.
